scenes.name: THE MIRROR ON 1/2
lines: Every interesting zero of zeta lives in a narrow strip between zero and one.
ζ 函数所有有意思的零点，都住在 0 与 1 之间的一条窄带里。
Down its middle runs a mirror: real part one half.
窄带正中立着一面镜子：实部等于 1/2。
Push a zero off the mirror, and the functional equation forces a twin on the other side.
把一个零点推离镜面，函数方程就会在对岸逼出它的孪生。
Fake zeros from extra Euler factors are harmless: they sit where the real part is zero.
多余欧拉因子的“冒牌零点”无害：它们都待在实部为 0 的线上。

scenes.name: PRIME SHADOW
lines: Now listen to the primes: weigh each prime power by its log, and subtract the trend.
现在听听素数：给每个素数幂按对数加权，再减去主趋势。
What is left is a faint hum, trapped inside a thin √x envelope.
剩下的只是一阵微弱的嗡鸣，被关在一条细细的 √x 包络里。
One zero off the line would roar, and break that ceiling near x = 67.
而只要有一个零点离线，它就会咆哮，在 x ≈ 67 附近冲破天花板。
Landau's trap turns this around: hold the hum below x^θ, and zeta has no zeros right of θ.
朗道陷阱反过来用：把嗡鸣压在 x^θ 之下，ζ 在 θ 右边就没有零点。

scenes.name: DIFFERENTIATING INTEGERS
lines: Counting zeros one at a time is too timid. Stepanov's trick makes every zero count many times.
一个一个数零点，太胆怯了。Stepanov 的妙招：让每个零点都算很多次。
x⁵ hugs the axis so flatly that a single root counts five times.
x⁵ 平平地贴着横轴，一个根就算作五重。
Over the integers you cannot divide by factorials, so use divided powers: every lowering step stays inside the box.
整数里不能随便除以阶乘，于是改用除幂：每一步降次都留在格子里。

scenes.name: √X MIRRORS
lines: Now chain the mirrors. Each theta lift climbs one rung, about √X rungs in all.
现在把镜子串起来：每次 Theta 提升爬上一级，总共约 √X 级。
At the top, the period is tangled up with Hecke characters. A seesaw trades it for a clean Bessel period.
到了链顶，周期和 Hecke 特征缠在一起；跷跷板把它换成干净的 Bessel 周期。
Lean checks the Gauss identity behind each mirror: go there and back, and you get exactly q times where you started.
Lean 检验了每面镜子背后的高斯恒等式：去一次再回来，恰好是原来的 q 倍。

scenes.name: BREAKING 2/3
lines: But one character alone hits a wall: its zero-free edge stalls at two thirds.
可单靠一个特征会撞墙：它的无零点边界卡在 2/3。
So glue many nearly orthogonal characters, and the Harder–Narasimhan roof of the lattice flattens.
那就把许多近乎正交的特征粘起来，格的 Harder–Narasimhan 屋顶随之压平。
Lean checks the short-vector bound under that roof. The curve slips below two thirds, toward one half.
屋顶下的短向量界由 Lean 检验。曲线滑过 2/3，奔向 1/2。

scenes.name: CLOSING THE NET
lines: Last, Behrend's sphere: the midpoint of two points on one shell always falls strictly inside.
最后是 Behrend 球：同一层球壳上两点的中点，总是严格落在球内。
So no three line up evenly. Sets like this open dense windows, and the net closes over every Dirichlet character.
所以壳上没有三点等距成线。这样的集合打开稠密窗口，网收拢到每个狄利克雷特征。
No zero survives right of one half. The mirror holds, and Lean has checked it.
1/2 右边再无零点幸存。镜子守住了，Lean 已检验。
